text: Hue breaks ground on $76m social housing project

A consortium comprising DICERA Holdings Joint Stock Company and Thuan An Construction and Investment Company Limited broke ground on a social housing project in Phong Thai Ward, central Hue City, on November 14.
The project covers a total planned area of 26.17 hectares, including approximately 11.76 hectares designated for social housing development.

With an estimated investment of more than VND2 trillion ($76 million), it will provide 1,680 two-storey terraced social housing units featuring four different designs to accommodate the needs of various household types.
According to the master plan, the development is expected to provide homes for approximately 7,000 residents.
The project is scheduled for implementation over seven years, from 2026 to 2033.

Beyond increasing the supply of affordable housing, the development is expected to generate additional employment and stimulate demand for construction materials, equipment, trade and services, contributing to local socio-economic development.
